original_data.question: How did Gordon do compared to John Henderson in the 1919 Aberdeenshire and Kincardineshire Central by-election?
original_data.answer: The Liberal candidate John Henderson lost to Gordon by the margin of 638 votes in the 1919 Aberdeenshire and Kincardineshire Central by-election. John Henderson obtained 5908 votes whereas Gordon obtained 6546 votes.
